reuse.name_matching: A catalogue entry is matched by getModelColor(entry.label).name; if that is not one of the five canonical names, by getModelColor(entry.key with underscores read as spaces).name. Only a name equal to one of the five getAllModelColors names counts (its rung). An entry with no such name is UNMATCHED: it lists after the matched ones in catalogue order and gets color null, so it carries no colour. Matching is on the returned name, not on the colour, because getModelColor returns an extended colour for every unknown name. Fixed Income is the live case (surprise IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W87-S4).
